How to read these scores

A complete composite requires one eligible, unique observation for every positive-weight component. Missing observations are not zeroes. Incomplete rows show mathematical bounds on a possible composite; those bounds are not confidence intervals and do not support a full-score ranking.

Scores summarize the named observation under its benchmark version and recorded conditions. They do not establish provider-wide capability, product readiness, or insurance suitability.
